newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LOMU IS THE PERFECT GUEST FOR EBBW VALE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LOMU IS THE PERFECT GUEST FOR EBBW VALE.

text.p: Winger Jonah Lomu swapped his New Zealand All Black jersey for the colours of Ebbw Vale on Wednesday, marking his debut as a guest for the Welsh club with a late try.

Ebbw Vale were beaten 65-59 by a Welsh Invitation XV as Lomu made his third appearance in the past 12 months in Wales, having played in former national skipper Ieuan Evans' testimonial and also as a guest for lower division club Wrexham.
Lomu, whose manager Phil Kingsley-Jones is the father of Vale skipper and Wales flanker Kingsley Jones, is enjoying a fortnight's holiday before returning home for Christmas.
There was precious little to tax him, a second-half conversion attempt which he sent wide and a one-handed 40 metre line-out throw being the highlights before his hugely popular try.
Lomu hardly broke sweat, allowing his brother John on Vale's right wing much more possession.
